purpose: Post-freeze check on additional development windows that were not scored in the earlier free-prediction or control comparisons listed in the previous calibration protocol; these are not independent new seizures.
subject: HUP080
fit: Two other development runs, with previous and candidate controllers using identical fold-trained model, preictal target convention, mask and bounds.
comparison: Mean across contacts and then windows, averaging simulation banks within windows. Calculate both occupation and time-resolved W1 and report paired old-vs-new differences, subgroup effects, and same-budget (not equal-energy) checks. No new experiment designs or checkpoint changes after examining these windows.
scoring_reference: Held development run's preictal segments 15:30, only used for scoring, not given to the policies.
evaluation_noise: Use exactly the pre-existing history-only scale rule and matched standard normal draws for all arms. The intra-window scale is fixed.
